# Owned callback output array factory fixture

A static factory has two independent Object-bounded formals. A complete
Function consumes T and produces U, the exact U array supplies the output
context, and an invariant Comparator result retains T. Boolean and default
false overloads preserve the original varargs metadata and fixed array ABI.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every unit and compare all original
entries, fields, metadata and Exceptions. Frozen callers run 144 fresh JVM
cases twice through four entry routes, checking exact function/array identity,
nulls, cyclic and covariant arrays, both flags, mutations, opaque results and
exact factory/callback/late comparison failures. Six wrong programs and six
Code-preserving Signature controls protect scope and slot direction. Only
owned fixture code executes; use JDK 21 and release 8.
